name: Us
title: The ancestor of Edom and the founder of Job's homeland
summary: Us (Hebrew: עוּץ) was the son of Aram and the grandson of Shem, Noah's son. He is known as the patriarch of the people and land of Uz, which later became the home of the righteous Job. The name Us is also associated with other individuals in the Bible, including a son of Nahor, Abraham's brother.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Us is listed as the firstborn son of Aram, son of Shem, in the post-flood genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Us' place in Shem's lineage is confirmed in 1 Chronicles as part of humanity's early genealogical history.

keyEvents.title: Another Us, a son of Nahor
keyEvents.description: Another person named Us is mentioned as the firstborn son of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and his wife Milcah.

keyEvents.title: The land of Uz as Job's homeland
keyEvents.description: The land of Uz was the home of the righteous Job, known for his piety and suffering. The land was likely named after the patriarch Us.

keyEvents.title: The land of Uz mentioned in Lamentations
keyEvents.description: The prophet Jeremiah mentions the land of Uz in connection with Edom's daughter, who must also drink from God's cup of wrath.

keyEvents.title: The land of Uz in Jeremiah's prophecies
keyEvents.description: Jeremiah prophesies that the kings in the land of Uz will drink from the Lord's cup of wrath along with other nations under God's judgment.
